project_type: TypeScript monorepo - browser-based 2D MMO life simulation
build_system: pnpm workspace monorepo with turborepo for orchestration
test_framework: Vitest for unit tests, Playwright for E2E
verification_instructions: 1. Run pnpm install at root. 2. Run pnpm build to compile all packages. 3. Run pnpm test to run unit tests. 4. Run pnpm dev to start development server and verify game loads in browser.
setup_instructions: 1. Clone the repo. 2. Run pnpm install at root. 3. Copy .env.example to .env.local and fill in Supabase credentials. 4. Run pnpm dev.
environment_constraints: Open internet - full access to npm registry, Docker hub, etc. Node.js v22.23.1, pnpm 10.28.1, Docker 5.2.3 available.
contribution_requirements: Use conventional commits. All code in TypeScript with strict mode. Use ESLint + Prettier. Follow Clean Architecture and ECS patterns in game engine.
key_patterns: Monorepo with pnpm workspaces. Shared packages for types, utils, game-engine. Next.js App Router for web app. Phaser 3 for game rendering. Supabase for auth/realtime/database. Zustand for client state. ECS (Entity Component System) for game logic.
directory_structure: apps/web - Next.js app with Phaser game canvas | packages/game-engine - ECS game engine with world, player, chunk systems | packages/shared - shared types, constants, utils | packages/database - Supabase schema, migrations, client | packages/ui - shared UI components with TailwindCSS
